title: Halogen boiling points
caption: Halogen molecules get larger down the group, with more electrons, so London forces between them strengthen and boiling points rise: fluorine and chlorine are gases, bromine a liquid and iodine a solid at room temperature.
alt: Bar chart of boiling points: F₂ −188, Cl₂ −34, Br₂ 59, I₂ 184 °C.
